reason: The original decision rule did not distinguish a completed zero-score trajectory from another trajectory censored by the 60-step cap. Upstream MiniSWE defaults to 300 steps, and the calibration trajectory remained active beyond step 37 when this amendment was frozen.

revised_decision_rule.headroom_confirmed: Checkpoint-3 no-transfer Core is at least 2/8, regardless of whether the agent used the full budget.
revised_decision_rule.borderline_completed: Checkpoint-3 no-transfer Core is 1/8 and the agent completed before the 60-step cap; run one additional 60-step no-transfer worker.
revised_decision_rule.headroom_not_confirmed: Checkpoint-3 no-transfer Core is 0/8 and the agent completed before the 60-step cap; abandon code_search for the main transfer contrast.
revised_decision_rule.budget_censored_again: The trajectory reaches 60 steps without issuing the MiniSWE completion command. Do not use its score to abandon code_search. Run at most one 120-step no-transfer calibration worker, then decide using completion status and Core score.
revised_decision_rule.maximum_calibration: Do not escalate beyond a single 120-step calibration worker for this model-task pair.

unchanged.treatment_arms: remain prohibited until checkpoint-3 headroom is confirmed
